plan.notes: Source: Columbus State Community College official online catalog (explore.cscc.edu, academia-nut API), program 'Associate of Science - Computer and Information Science' (CIS.AS). Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the catalog's semester sections. Catalog year honesty: the API exposes no explicit catalog year; program data was synced September 2026, so catalog_year is set to 2026-2027 (the academic year in effect at sync time). Catalog OR-slots (alternatives occupying one slot) are transcribed as single choice slots resolved at minimum credits; AND-bundles are kept together. Generic elective slots use the catalog's own slot text. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence is empty.
